meta.source: locker views at each vendor tab; the price a vendor shows over an item in your locker is what that vendor pays for it
rules: value is the number as displayed (a K amount is the displayed amount, e.g. $2.5K = 2500)
an item in checked_items with no row for a vendor was shown with no price at that vendor, so that vendor does not buy it (as of the screenshots)
items with uses left (kits, bandages, packs) are priced by uses left, noted per row
item = the in-game short name; long names only where confirmed
rows with src "earlier screenshots" come from the 2026-11-02 batch; those items were only looked at for one vendor, so other vendors are unchecked (shown as ? on the page)
standing: do not track ammo or magazines (user decision 2026-11-03)
ignored on purpose: helmets (Crusher), weapons, ammo, magazines, grenades (M67, F-1), USD stacks, backpacks (Rush, Trekstars)

rows with "ver":"0.5.1.0" were read after patch 0.5.1.0 and override older rows for the same vendor and item; "nobuy":true marks a vendor that showed the item without a price after the patch (shown as the X mark)
